mu_name_from: MuMain's MODEL_DESTORY_* (_enum.h: MODEL_GLOVE + 47), loaded from Data/Player/GloveMale48.bmd by the index-plus-one rule. MU's number 47; ours is *Male48. OpenMU spells the armour, pants and boots 'Destory' (MU's MODEL_DESTORY_*), the gloves 'Destroy'; ours is Destroy throughout.
why_this_one: The missing-gear audit, 2026-10-23: the last sets missing at drop levels 93-132, which Kanturu's monsters reach (the user: 'we need to build all kanturu weapons and armors'). Destroy is the Magic Gladiator's.

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (0.75 and 0.95d have none).
stats.class_level_note: OpenMU's magicGladiatorClassLevel 1, its only class. No helm: OpenMU has no row for one (MuMain's HelmMale48.bmd is left unbuilt).

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under MU's own names, lower-cased (an .OZT beside its .OZJ takes _t): dark steel traced in pink; Item4001_cloth the tabard; Item4001_R a pink orb.
material_note: plate_steel: Destroy is grey steel traced in pink, not lacquer (the user, 2026-10-23: 'i think MG metal could be more metaalic no?'). Its tabard cloth.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_DESTORY_*; the pink orbs are added, see glow_note. Its full-set bonus is not given: sim::setDefense counts only Storm Crow and Hurricane for the Magic Gladiator.
glow_note: Item4001_R's `_R` makes TextureScript draw those meshes bright (TextureScript.cpp parsingTScriptA, ZzzBMD.cpp:2238): the pink orbs added, out of the bake, steady at BlendMeshLight 1 -- MuMain has no arm that moves it (the user, 2026-10-23: 'Glow steadily, as MU').
